name: CoinMetriq
tagline: Market data without the noise. Understand digital assets with free, practical tools.

tool.title: Token Market Cap Calculator
tool.intro: Estimate the market capitalization of a token using a price and circulating supply.
tool.formula: Multiply the unit price by circulating token supply. This is a mathematical estimate, not a live market quote.
tool.caution: Prices and supply are entered by you; check reliable market sources before making decisions.
